description.en: Talk about your friends, invite people out, agree on a time and place, and say yes or no politely, including by text.
description.so: Ka hadal saaxiibbadaa, dadka u yeer inaad dibadda u baxdaan, ku heshiiya waqti iyo meel, oo si edeb leh u dheh haa ama maya, xataa fariin qoraal ah.

body.en: Rafiki is a friend. In school Swahili the plural is also rafiki, but Kenyans very often say marafiki. Mwenzangu (my mate) is used for classmates, colleagues and anyone you share something with. Close friends drop by, share food and help each other with money and jobs. You met the Sheng word beshte (best friend) in the Family unit.
body.so: Rafiki waa saaxiib. Sawaaxiliga dugsiga wadartuna waa rafiki, laakiin Kenyaanku inta badan waxay yiraahdaan marafiki. Mwenzangu (jaalkay) waxaa loo isticmaalaa ardayda fasalka, asxaabta shaqada iyo qof kasta oo aad wax la wadaagto. Saaxiibbada dhow way is booqdaan, cuntada way wadaagaan, waxayna isku caawiyaan lacag iyo shaqo. Erayga Sheng ee beshte (saaxiibka ugu fiican) waxaad ku baratay cutubka Qoyska.

body.en: Invite with Twende (let's go) plus a verb ending in -e: Twende tutembee (let's go for a walk), Twende tutazame mpira (let's go and watch football). Fix the place with Tukutane wapi? and the time with Tukutane saa ngapi? Remember Swahili time: saa nane mchana is 2 p.m., saa moja jioni is 7 p.m.
body.so: Ku martiqaad Twende (aan tagno) iyo fal ku dhammaada -e: Twende tutembee (aan socod u baxno), Twende tutazame mpira (aan u tagno oo kubadda cagta daawanno). Meesha ku go'aami Tukutane wapi? waqtigana Tukutane saa ngapi? Xusuuso waqtiga Sawaaxiliga: saa nane mchana waa 2 galabnimo, saa moja jioni waa 7 fiidnimo.

examples.en: Let's meet at two in the afternoon.

title.so: Maya oo aan maya la oran

body.en: A flat Hapana! can sound harsh. Kenyans soften a refusal: Pole, siwezi leo (Sorry, I can't today), Labda wikendi ijayo (Maybe next weekend). Nitaona (I'll see) and Nitajaribu (I'll try) often politely mean no, so don't count on that friend!
body.so: Hapana! oo qallafsan waxay u ekaan kartaa mid adag. Kenyaanku way jilciyaan diidmada: Pole, siwezi leo (Waan ka xumahay, maanta ma awoodo), Labda wikendi ijayo (Malaha dhammaadka toddobaadka soo socda). Nitaona (Waan ka fiirsan doonaa) iyo Nitajaribu (Waan isku dayi doonaa) badanaa si edeb leh ayay maya u tilmaamaan, markaa saaxiibkaas ha isku hallayn!

examples.sw: Pole, siwezi leo. Labda wikendi ijayo.
examples.en: Sorry, I can't today. Maybe next weekend.
examples.so: Waan ka xumahay, maanta ma awoodo. Malaha dhammaadka toddobaadka soo socda.

body.en: Kenyan texts mix Swahili, English and Sheng. People drop vowels (nko njiani for niko njiani, nmefika for nimefika), write sai for sasa hivi and add English freely: Nitakutext later. This course teaches the full forms so you can read and say them, but don't be surprised by the short versions.
body.so: Fariimaha Kenya waxay isku daraan Sawaaxili, Ingiriis iyo Sheng. Dadku shaqallada way tuuraan (nko njiani halkii niko njiani, nmefika halkii nimefika), waxay qoraan sai halkii sasa hivi, Ingiriisna si xor ah ayay ugu daraan: Nitakutext later. Koorsadani waxay baraysaa qaababka buuxa si aad u akhrido oo aad u dhawaaqdo, laakiin ha la yaabin qaababka gaagaaban.

examples.en: I'm on my way, I'll be there in a moment.
examples.so: Waan soo socdaa, hadda ayaan imanayaa.

note.en: Rafiki yangu = my friend. Plural: rafiki in school Swahili, marafiki in everyday Kenyan speech.
note.so: Rafiki yangu = saaxiibkay. Wadarta: rafiki Sawaaxiliga dugsiga, marafiki hadalka maalinlaha ah ee Kenya.

note.en: From mwenzi (companion). Mwenzako = your mate, wenzangu = my mates.
note.so: Waxay ka timid mwenzi (wehel). Mwenzako = jaalkaa, wenzangu = jaalladayda.

note.en: Tu- (we) + -li- (past) + soma (study). Many Kenyan friendships start at school.
note.so: Tu- (annaga) + -li- (waqti tegay) + soma (wax baro). Saaxiibtinimo badan oo Kenya ah waxay ka bilaabataa dugsiga.

items.en: We've known each other a long time

note.en: -ana = each other: kujua (to know), kujuana (to know each other).
note.so: -ana = midba midka kale: kujua (aqoon), kujuana (is aqoon).

note.en: Kenyans mix in English free. The fully Swahili way: Una nafasi Jumamosi?
note.so: Kenyaanku waxay ku daraan erayga Ingiriiska free. Qaabka Sawaaxili ee buuxa: Una nafasi Jumamosi?

note.en: Add a verb ending in -e: Twende tutembee = Let's go for a walk.
note.so: Ku dar fal ku dhammaada -e: Twende tutembee = Aan socod u baxno.

note.en: Swahili time counts from sunrise: saa nane is the eighth hour, so 2 p.m.
note.so: Waqtiga Sawaaxiligu wuxuu ka bilaabmaa qorrax-ka-soo-bax: saa nane waa saacadda siddeedaad, markaa 2 galabnimo.

note.en: Ni-ta-ku-pigia = I-will-you-call. Nipigie = call me.
note.so: Ni-ta-ku-pigia = aniga-waan-ku-wici doonaa. Nipigie = i soo wac.

note.en: Lit. without doubt.
note.so: Macnaha: shaki la'aan.

note.en: In Sheng you will also hear Nitakam.
note.so: Sheng waxaad sidoo kale maqli doontaa Nitakam.

note.en: Kenyans often use pole (sympathy) as a soft 'sorry' here. Samahani, siwezi also works.
note.so: Kenyaanku badanaa halkan pole (tacsi) waxay u isticmaalaan 'ka xumahay' jilicsan. Samahani, siwezi sidoo kale waa sax.

note.en: Often written niko bize. Standard: Nina shughuli nyingi.
note.so: Badanaa waxaa loo qoraa niko bize. Caadiga: Nina shughuli nyingi.

note.en: Labda = maybe, ijayo = next (lit. that is coming).
note.so: Labda = malaha, ijayo = soo socda.

note.en: Often a polite way of saying no.
note.so: Badanaa waa hab edeb leh oo maya lagu yiraahdo.

note.en: From English. The standard form is mwisho wa wiki.
note.so: Waxay ka timid Ingiriiska. Qaabka caadiga ahi waa mwisho wa wiki.

note.en: Kanisa = church; kanisani = at or to church. Sunday mornings are busy on Kenyan roads.
note.so: Kanisa = kaniisad; kanisani = kaniisadda (ku jira ama loo socdo). Axadda subaxdeeda waddooyinka Kenya way mashquul yihiin.

note.en: Msikiti = mosque; msikitini = at or to the mosque. Friday prayers fill the mosques of Eastleigh and Mombasa.
note.so: Msikiti = masjid; msikitini = masjidka (ku jira ama loo socdo). Salaadda Jimcaha masaajidda Eastleigh iyo Mombasa way buuxdaa.

note.en: Mpira = ball, and also football. Many Kenyans watch big matches together in cafés and halls.
note.so: Mpira = kubad, sidoo kale kubadda cagta. Kenyaan badan ciyaaraha waaweyn waxay ku wada daawadaan makhaayadaha iyo hoolalka.

note.en: Standard: kwenda ufukweni. In Mombasa families head to the beach on Sunday afternoons.
note.so: Caadiga: kwenda ufukweni. Mombasa, qoysasku Axadda galabtii xeebta ayay aadaan.

items.en: to walk / to go out and about

note.en: Kutembelea means to visit: Nitamtembelea shangazi = I'll visit my aunt.
note.so: Kutembelea waxay ka dhigan tahay booqasho: Nitamtembelea shangazi = Eeddo ayaan booqan doonaa.

note.en: Lit. to eat outside. Twende tukale nje leo = Let's go and eat out today.
note.so: Macnaha: dibadda wax ku cunid. Twende tukale nje leo = Aan maanta dibadda wax ka cunno.

note.en: Lit. I'm on the road. A Kenyan joke: sometimes it means 'I haven't left yet'!
note.so: Macnaha: waddada ayaan ku jiraa. Kaftan Kenya: mararka qaar waxay ka dhigan tahay 'weli ma bixin'!

note.en: Karibu here means near. Niko karibu = I'm nearly there.
note.so: Karibu halkan waxay ka dhigan tahay u dhow. Niko karibu = Waan soo dhowaaday.

note.en: Lit. let's see each other tomorrow.
note.so: Macnaha: berri aan is aragno.

items.so: Fariin ayaan kuu soo diri doonaa

note.en: English text with Swahili grammar. Standard: Nitakutumia ujumbe.
note.so: Erayga Ingiriiska text oo leh naxwe Sawaaxili. Caadiga: Nitakutumia ujumbe.

note.en: Kujibu = to reply; hujibu = you don't reply. Mbona is the everyday Kenyan 'why'.
note.so: Kujibu = jawaabid; hujibu = ma jawaabtid. Mbona waa 'maxay' maalinlaha Kenya.

items.so: Goobta aad joogto ii soo dir

note.en: Kenyans use the English word for a map pin sent by phone.
note.so: Kenyaanku waxay isticmaalaan erayga Ingiriiska ee goobta taleefanka lagu diro.

note.en: Young people shorten it to sai in speech and texts. Nafika sasa hivi = I'll be there in a moment.
note.so: Dhallinyaradu hadalka iyo fariimaha waxay u soo gaabiyaan sai. Nafika sasa hivi = Dhawaan ayaan imanayaa.

items.en: I've added you to the group

note.en: Kenyans plan almost everything in phone chat groups. Kwa is the everyday Kenyan 'in'; standard: kwenye kikundi.
note.so: Kenyaanku wax walba waxay ku qorsheeyaan kooxaha sheekada taleefanka. Kwa waa 'ku' maalinlaha Kenya; caadiga: kwenye kikundi.

lines.sw: Halima, huyu ni rafiki yangu Wanjiku.
lines.en: Halima, this is my friend Wanjiku.
lines.so: Halima, kani waa saaxiibaddayda Wanjiku.

lines.en: Welcome, Wanjiku! Where did you two meet?
lines.so: Soo dhawoow, Wanjiku! Xaggee iska barteen?

lines.en: We studied together in Garissa.
lines.so: Garissa ayaan wax ku wada baranay.

lines.en: Yes, we've known each other a very long time!
lines.so: Haa, muddo aad u dheer ayaan is naqaannay!

question.en: Where did Amina and Wanjiku meet?
question.so: Amina iyo Wanjiku xaggee bay iska barteen?

lines.en: Hi Baraka! Are you free on Saturday?
lines.so: Haye Baraka! Sabtida waqti ma haysataa?

lines.en: Yes. What's up?
lines.so: Haa. Maxaa jira?

lines.en: Let's go and watch football at Kasarani!
lines.so: Aan u tagno Kasarani oo kubadda cagta daawanno!

lines.en: Cool! What time shall we meet?
lines.so: Fiican! Goorma ayaan kulannaa?

lines.sw: Tukutane saa nane, nje ya uwanja.
lines.en: Let's meet at two, outside the stadium.
lines.so: Aan ku kulanno labada galabnimo, garoonka bannaankiisa.

explain.en: Wapi asks 'where', so answer with a place. Saa nane mchana answers 'what time?'.
explain.so: Wapi waxay weydiisaa 'xaggee', markaa ku jawaab meel. Saa nane mchana waxay ka jawaabtaa 'goorma?'.

prompt.so: Berri ayaan ku soo wici doonaa

explain.en: 'Shall we go for a walk on Sunday?' – 'Sorry, I can't. Maybe next weekend.'
explain.so: 'Axadda ma socod baan u baxnaa?' – 'Waan ka xumahay, ma awoodo. Malaha dhammaadka toddobaadka soo socda.'

lines.en: Mwikali, are you free tomorrow evening?
lines.so: Mwikali, berri fiidkii waqti ma haysataa?

lines.sw: Pole, siwezi. Nina shughuli nyingi kazini.
lines.en: Sorry, I can't. I have a lot to do at work.
lines.so: Waan ka xumahay, ma awoodo. Shaqo badan ayaan hayaa.

lines.en: Okay. And what about Saturday?
lines.so: Hagaag. Sabtidase?

lines.en: Saturday, definitely! I'll come.
lines.so: Sabtida, haa dabcan! Waan iman doonaa.

meaning.en: Sorry, I can't today. Maybe next weekend.
meaning.so: Waan ka xumahay, maanta ma awoodo. Malaha dhammaadka toddobaadka soo socda.

lines.en: Kamau, what will you do this weekend?
lines.so: Kamau, dhammaadka toddobaadkan maxaad samayn doontaa?

lines.sw: Jumapili asubuhi naenda kanisani. Mchana tutatazama mpira.
lines.en: On Sunday morning I'm going to church. In the afternoon we'll watch football.
lines.so: Axadda subaxdeeda kaniisadda ayaan tegayaa. Galabtii kubadda cagta ayaan daawan doonnaa.

lines.sw: Mimi Ijumaa naenda msikitini. Jumamosi tutaenda ufukweni na familia.
lines.en: I'm going to the mosque on Friday. On Saturday we'll go to the beach with the family.
lines.so: Anigu Jimcaha masjidka ayaan tegayaa. Sabtida qoyska ayaan xeebta la aadi doonnaa.

lines.sw: Poa! Jumapili jioni tukale nje pamoja?
lines.en: Cool! Shall we eat out together on Sunday evening?
lines.so: Fiican! Axadda fiidkeeda ma wada dibadda wax ka cunnaa?

lines.en: Definitely!
lines.so: Haa, dabcan!

question.en: Where is Abdi going on Friday?

meaning.en: On Sunday we're going to watch football at Kasarani.
meaning.so: Axadda waxaan u socdaa inaan kubadda cagta ka daawanno Kasarani.

prompt.so: Aan u baxno oo dibadda wax ka cunno

lines.en: Hello Omar, where are you?
lines.so: Haloo Omar, xaggee joogtaa?

lines.sw: Niko njiani, lakini niko kwa jam.
lines.en: I'm on my way, but I'm stuck in traffic.
lines.so: Waan soo socdaa, laakiin ciriiriga gaadiidka ayaan ku jiraa.

lines.en: Okay, I'll wait for you here at the café.
lines.so: Hagaag, halkan makhaayadda ayaan kugu sugi doonaa.

lines.en: Sorry, I'm late! I'm here now.
lines.so: Waan ka xumahay, waan soo daahay! Hadda waan imid.

options.en: He was in a traffic jam

explain.en: 'Where are you?' – 'I'm on my way, I'll be there in a moment.' (Sometimes that's not quite true!)
explain.so: 'Xaggee joogtaa?' – 'Waan soo socdaa, dhawaan ayaan imanayaa.' (Mararka qaar run ma aha!)

meaning.en: Sorry, I'm late! There was a traffic jam.
meaning.so: Waan ka xumahay, waan soo daahay! Ciriiri gaadiid ayaa jiray.

lines.en: Hey! What time are we meeting today?
lines.so: Iska warran! Maanta goorma ayaan kulmaynaa?

lines.sw: Saa kumi jioni. Nijulishe ukiwa njiani.
lines.en: At four in the afternoon. Let me know when you're on your way.
lines.so: Afarta galabnimo. I soo ogeysii markaad soo socoto.

lines.en: Okay. I'll tell the others too.
lines.so: Hagaag. Kuwa kalena waan u sheegi doonaa.

lines.en: Cool. When you arrive, call me.
lines.so: Fiican. Markaad timaaddo, i soo wac.

prompt.en: Let me know when you arrive

explain.en: 'I'll send you a message later, okay?' – 'Okay, cool!'
explain.so: 'Goor dambe fariin ayaan kuu soo diri doonaa, hagaag?' – 'Hagaag, fiican!'

meaning.en: I'm on my way, I'll be there in a moment.
meaning.so: Waan soo socdaa, dhawaan ayaan imanayaa.
